name: Infant Baptism
overview: Scripture emphasizes the necessity of personal faith and repentance for salvation, as seen in passages like Mark 16:16 and Acts 2:38-41, where belief and baptism follow receiving the gospel. Jesus welcomes children to come to Him (Matthew 19:14), affirming their value in the kingdom of heaven, yet baptism is commanded as part of making disciples among all nations (Matthew 28:19). John 3:5 highlights the spiritual rebirth through water and the Spirit, underscoring that entry into God's kingdom requires a born-again experience, which the sample verses associate with conscious belief and repentance rather than infant baptism.
